content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Public Enterprises Selection Board has advertised 1 post for Chairman & Managing Director (a schedule 'A' CPSE) in Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: On the date of occurrence of vacancy (01.05.2027), the age of superannuation is 60 years. For internal candidates, the minimum age is 45 years with 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation. For other candidates, the minimum age is 45 years with 3 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation. (i) The applicant should possess cumulative experience/exposure for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project Management in a large organization of repute. Applicants having experience in Power Sector/ Infrastructure Finance will be given preference. (ii) The applicants should possess cumulative experience of at least 5 years in core HR/IR/Personnel Management along with at least 3 years cumulative experience during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project Management in a large organization of repute. Applicants having experience in Power Sector/ Infrastructure Finance will be given preference. The applicant must, on the date of application, as well as on the date of interview, be employed in a regular capacity – and not in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity – in one of the following: Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) including a full-time functional Director on the Board; Central Government Group 'A' Officers including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies, etc.; State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) where annual turnover is Rs. 10,000 crore or more; Private Sector Company/ Joint Venture (JV) [50:50 JVs of Central Government/ State Governments and JVs of CPSEs with other CPSEs/ organisations (50:50 JVs)]/ National and State level Cooperative Federations whose annual turnover is Rs. 10,000 crore or more. content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The selection process is conducted by the Public Enterprises Selection Board through a selection meeting for qualified candidates short-listed for interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PFC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill up the Application Form online only against the Job Description on the website of PESB - PESB Application Form . Submit the application through the proper channel based on your employment category (such as Cadre Controlling Authority, Administrative Ministry, or Competent Authority). Ensure the application is submitted online by the applicant by 03:00 PM on 30.10.2026. Ensure the nodal officer or competent authority forwards the online application to PESB by 17.00 hours on 09.11.2026. Attach required documents including annual reports, board-level evidence, age proof, qualification certificates, and the 13 points proforma vigilance profile prescribed by CVC where applicable.
